title: Take Your Seat
subtitle: One bell, and the table is called to order
description: One bell, and the table is called to order. Everything below waits
on this quest, and this quest waits on nothing.
It is also the file to look at first if you want to see the
chapter's default in action: this quest has no prerequisite mode
of its own, so the chapter's `one_started` applies to its
